title: AFKay
description: Tired of getting kicked for being AFK? AFKay silently keeps you connected so you never lose your spot again.
body:
# AFKay

  Never get kicked for being idle again.

  ## What it does
  AFKay runs quietly in the background and sends tiny invisible packets to the server
  every few seconds, resetting its idle timer before it can kick you. There's no visible
  movement, no cheating — just you, staying connected while you step away.

  ## Features
  - Automatically active the moment you join a world
  - Toggle on/off with a keybind (default: K) without leaving the game
  - On/off status shown in your action bar when you press the key
  - Works on any server — no server-side install required
  - Zero performance impact

  ## How to use
  1. Install the mod (requires Fabric Loader + Fabric API)
  2. Join any server as normal
  3. AFK protection is on by default — you don't have to do anything
  4. Press K to toggle it off/on if needed

  ## Requirements
  - Minecraft 1.20.1
  - Fabric Loader
  - Fabric API
